description:
FILED + FIXED s518e (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-17) from the Type-Tiny census (t/00-begin.t: `eval "use $module ()"; $version = $module->VERSION;` for every optional module).

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs main 5c5a5679):

    my $m = "Return::Type"; my $v = $m->VERSION; print defined $v ? "def" : "undef", "\n";

perl: undef.  PCL: dies `Can't locate object method "VERSION" via package "Return::Type" (perhaps you forgot to load ...)`.

CAUSE: p-method-call's unknown-package branch let can / isa / DOES fall through to the UNIVERSAL fallback and died for every other method; VERSION is the fourth UNIVERSAL method.

=== DONE (s518e) ===
cl/pcl-runtime.lisp: VERSION joins can/isa/DOES in that list.  Guard Pl/t/universal-01.t row 9 (perl oracle), fails on main.  Type-Tiny t/00-begin.t: 0 rows -> 1/0 = perl.
subject: Class->VERSION on a package that was never declared dies "Can't locate object method VERSION via package" -- perl answers undef (UNIVERSAL::VERSION is valid on any class name, like can/isa/DOES); Type-Tiny t/00-begin.t dies on its optional-module report
